intro: The portfolio monitoring team of {bank} is conducting its periodic covenant compliance review of the commercial loan portfolio, which covers the {n} borrowers identified as {first} through {last}. For each borrower, the team must determine the covenant ratios for the requested test period, whether each covenant tested by that borrower's credit agreement is met, and whether the borrower is in compliance overall. All amounts appearing in the files are stated in thousands of US dollars.
rule_general: The test period is the fiscal year ending on the date named in the compliance certificate request in the correspondence file, and every figure used in a calculation must come from the statement column for that fiscal year. A dash in a statement means the line was not reported and counts as zero. Each tested covenant applies with the definitions of the agreement as amended. An amendment changes the agreement only for test periods ending on or after the date it states, and when several executed amendments change the same item for the test period, the one with the latest such date governs. Draft amendments that were never executed have no effect. Ratios are computed from unrounded figures and rounded only at the end. A covenant with a maximum is met when the ratio is at or below the maximum, and a covenant with a minimum is met when the ratio is at or above the minimum. A borrower is in compliance only if every tested covenant is met.
rule_answer: End the reply with one JSON object keyed by borrower id. For each borrower, include an entry for every covenant that borrower's agreement tests, under the keys "net_leverage", "interest_coverage" and "current_ratio"; each entry is an object with "ratio" (a number rounded to two decimals) and "pass" (true or false), and the borrower object also includes "compliant" (true or false). A reported ratio within one hundredth of the exact value counts as correct. Covenants the agreement does not test are omitted. The answer must follow this format: {example}.
agreement_title: Excerpt of Financial Covenants and Related Definitions from the Credit Agreement of {name}, dated as of {date}
def_debt_incl: "Consolidated Total Debt" means the sum of long-term debt (current and noncurrent portions), short-term borrowings and finance lease liabilities (current and noncurrent portions); operating lease liabilities are excluded.
def_debt_excl: "Consolidated Total Debt" means the sum of long-term debt (current and noncurrent portions) and short-term borrowings; finance lease liabilities and operating lease liabilities are excluded.
def_net_full: "Net Leverage Ratio" means Consolidated Total Debt minus unrestricted cash and cash equivalents, divided by Consolidated EBITDA.
def_net_cap: "Net Leverage Ratio" means Consolidated Total Debt minus unrestricted cash and cash equivalents, provided that the amount of cash deducted shall not exceed {cap} (thousands of US dollars), divided by Consolidated EBITDA.
def_ebitda_cap: "Consolidated EBITDA" means operating income plus depreciation and amortization, plus the following items to the extent deducted in computing operating income: {addbacks}; provided that the aggregate amount added back for those listed items shall not exceed {pct} percent of the sum of operating income and depreciation and amortization.
def_ebitda_nocap: "Consolidated EBITDA" means operating income plus depreciation and amortization, plus the following items to the extent deducted in computing operating income: {addbacks}; no limit applies to these add-backs.
def_coverage: "Interest Coverage Ratio" means Consolidated EBITDA divided by interest expense.
def_current: "Current Ratio" means total current assets divided by total current liabilities.
cov_leverage: The Net Leverage Ratio for any test period shall not exceed {max}.
cov_leverage_step: The Net Leverage Ratio shall not exceed {max1} for any test period ending on or before {date}, and shall not exceed {max2} for any test period ending after that date.
cov_coverage: The Interest Coverage Ratio for any test period shall not be less than {min}.
cov_current: The Current Ratio as of the last day of any test period shall not be less than {min}.
cure_right: A cash common equity contribution received by the Borrower within {days} days after the last day of a test period may, at the Borrower's election, be added to Consolidated EBITDA for that test period solely for computing the Net Leverage Ratio and for no other covenant.
amend_leverage: Amendment No. {k}, executed on {signed}: for every test period ending on or after {from}, the maximum Net Leverage Ratio is {max}, replacing any earlier level or schedule.
amend_coverage: Amendment No. {k}, executed on {signed}: for every test period ending on or after {from}, the minimum Interest Coverage Ratio is {min}.
amend_current: Amendment No. {k}, executed on {signed}: for every test period ending on or after {from}, the minimum Current Ratio is {min}.
amend_cap: Amendment No. {k}, executed on {signed}: for every test period ending on or after {from}, the add-back limit in the definition of Consolidated EBITDA is {pct} percent.
amend_fl_excl: Amendment No. {k}, executed on {signed}: for every test period ending on or after {from}, finance lease liabilities are excluded from Consolidated Total Debt.
amend_fl_incl: Amendment No. {k}, executed on {signed}: for every test period ending on or after {from}, finance lease liabilities (current and noncurrent) are included in Consolidated Total Debt.
amend_draft: Draft Amendment No. {k}, circulated on {signed} but never signed or executed: it proposed a maximum Net Leverage Ratio of {max}.
no_amendments: The amendment file contains no amendments.
request: Letter dated {date}: the agent bank requests the compliance certificate for the test period ending {end}.
cure_notice: Notice dated {date}: the Borrower received a cash common equity contribution of {amount} thousand US dollars and elects to apply it under the equity cure right to the test period ending {end}.
pad_notes: Letter dated {date}: the Borrower notifies the agent bank of a change of its notice address.
Letter dated {date}: the agent bank requests an updated certificate of insurance.
Letter dated {date}: the agent bank introduces a new relationship manager for the Borrower's account.
Letter dated {date}: the agent bank confirms an interest rate reset for the current interest period.
Letter dated {date}: the Borrower delivers an updated list of authorized signatories.
Letter dated {date}: the Borrower delivers updated know-your-customer documentation.
Letter dated {date}: the Borrower requests a conformed copy of the credit agreement for its records.
Letter dated {date}: the agent bank confirms a change of its payment and wire transfer instructions.
Letter dated {date}: the agent bank circulates the minutes of the annual lender meeting.
Letter dated {date}: the agent bank requests confirmation of the Borrower's legal entity identifier.
Letter dated {date}: the Borrower provides an updated management organizational chart.
Letter dated {date}: the agent bank acknowledges receipt of the annual agency fee.

labels.ltd_nc: Long-term debt, net of current portion

statement_title: Statement Excerpt for {name}: all figures are in thousands of US dollars and columns are fiscal years.

tools.list_borrowers: Lists the borrower ids and names in the portfolio, paged with offset and limit parameters.
tools.read_agreement: Returns the covenant excerpt of one borrower's credit agreement.
tools.read_correspondence: Returns one borrower's correspondence file, including the compliance certificate request.
tools.read_statements: Returns one borrower's statement excerpt covering three fiscal years.

unit_prompt: Using the tools, review only borrower {id}: read that borrower's credit agreement excerpt, amendment file, correspondence file and statement excerpt, apply the same rules, and end the reply with the JSON answer for that borrower in the format of {example}.
